personality_one_liner: A high-performance, command-center tracker built for speed, live metrics, and gamified competition, grounded in deep black with aggressive racing-red accents.

spacing.rule: Use tight spacing for metrics to ensure glanceability, with generous padding around cards and scroll boundaries. Avoid floating elements, anchor to the grid.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary and surfaceTertiary instead of blur to maintain maximum clarity and performance for tracking workflows.
dont's: Do not use glass or blur effects, this personality favors harsh structural hierarchy and deep blacks over layered translucency.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Login and registration flow with strong branding and aggressive styling.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with vertical dark gradient scrim (top to bottom). Large display typography for 'Flash CarX'. Single column form inputs with brandPrimary CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Daily dashboard with total earnings, quick wash logging, and immediate performance metrics.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for cards and metric numbers.
states.empty: Illustration of a clean car with 'Nenhuma lavagem hoje. Bora começar?'

screens.layout: Top section features the primary spendable/earned balance prominently in Rajdhani, paired with a progress bar towards the daily goal. Below are quick action buttons ('Registrar Lavagem'). A summary list of today's washes with names and values anchors the bottom.

screens.name: Ranking
screens.purpose: Gamified leaderboard showing friends' rankings by earnings and number of washes.

states.error: Failed to load ranking, retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky header with segmented control (Diário / Semanal / Mensal). The top 3 users highlighted in a podium-like or emphasized card layout at the top. Following is a stacked list of user rows displaying rank, avatar, username, and score/XP.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: Complete searchable history of all logged washes with filters.

states.empty: No wash history found for the selected filter.

screens.layout: Header with a search bar and filter chips (e.g., 'Este mês', 'Semana'). A dense, chronological stacked list of wash records. Each row shows the car model/name, date, total amount, and percentage earned. Use dividers, no shadows.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User profile with level/XP, achievements, and access to deeper analytics and settings.
screens.layout: A cover banner photo with a gradient-to-dark scrim. Avatar overlapping the banner. Below, a grid of high-level stats (Total Earned, Total Washes, Top Car). A list of navigation rows for 'Metas', 'Estatísticas', 'Amigos', and 'Configurações' using brandTertiary tinted icons.

auth_background.alt: Dark moody luxury car with red taillights

profile_banner.alt: Abstract curved layers of red dark shapes

empty_wash.alt: A person washing a dark sports car with soapy foam

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility DARK personality. Ensure no blur or glassmorphism is used anywhere. Instead, use solid surfaceSecondary (#121212) and surfaceTertiary (#181818) blocks for hierarchy.
Use 'Rajdhani' for all display titles, large metrics, scores, and balances to emphasize the command-center/racing aesthetic.
Use 'DM Sans' for labels, body copy, list item titles, and user inputs.
Borders (0.5pt to 1pt max) using the 'border' token (#262626) should be used heavily to create structure instead of shadows.
The primary red accent (#FF3342) represents action and performance. Use it sparingly for primary CTAs, active states, and critical data points. Do not over-saturate the screen with red.
Any time text overlays the auth_background or profile_banner images, use a mandatory vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse / deep dark) to ensure contrast.
Avoid floating action buttons (FABs). Embed 'Registrar Lavagem' prominently in the layout flow or at the top of the daily view.
Always wire haptics to critical gamified interactions: button presses, tab switches, logging a wash, and achieving a goal.
When displaying earnings, make the metric numbers huge and legible. Users should be able to read their daily total instantly.
